activation_steps: Purchase and download the module ZIP from the Odoo Apps Store
Extract into your custom addons path
Update the Apps list and install the module
Open Settings and complete the module configuration wizard
Assign security groups to the right users
Optional: load demo data for a guided evaluation
Go live and contact support if you need rollout help
